source: The Ontario Curriculum, Grades 1-8: The Arts (2009), Music, Fundamental Concepts for Grades 1 to 8: the elements of music and the grade that first names each concept
method: Generated by course/concepts.js from course/set.json. Each example is a span of bars that, written out and analysed on its own, shows the concept, while no shorter span inside it does; form is read from the sections and phrases, and a form of more than one part lists its parts (letter, bars, and the opening the piece view plays to compare them); "throughout" marks an idea heard in every bar, with the bar where it is clearest. Bars count every written bar from 1, a pickup bar included.

elements.name: duration
elements.words: long and short sounds: beat, rhythm, metre and tempo

elements.name: pitch
elements.words: high and low sounds: the notes, the steps and leaps between them, the scale

elements.name: dynamics and other expressive controls
elements.words: loud and soft, smooth and detached, and the marks that ask for them

elements.name: timbre
elements.words: tone colour: what makes one instrument or voice sound different from another

elements.name: texture/harmony
elements.words: how many sounds at once: a tune alone, a tune with chords, parts together

elements.name: form
elements.words: how the music is built: phrases, sections, and what repeats or returns
